name: Mahou no Tenshi Creamy Mami - Futatsu no Sekai no Monogatari
original_name: 魔法の天使クリィミーマミ 二つの世界の物語
source:
Based on the anime "Creamy Mami, the Magic Angel". The original tells the story of a 10-year-old girl named Yuu Morisawa, who gains a magical ability to transform into a grown-up young woman, eventually becoming a pop star and acquainting the inhabitants of the Earth with the rest of the galaxy. Yuu appears in the game, but is not the protagonist; the player controls four young women in four different scenarios: two of them, Yuri and Aya, on the Earth, and the other two, Ora and Sita, in an alien world, mixture of sci-fi and medieval fantasy. The story goes beyond the original anime by introducing a magical, sacred land known as Finality, populated by fantasy beings, and calling the guardians (the four girl protagonists) to bring peace to the galaxy.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/mah-no-tenshi-creamy-mami-futatsu-no-sekai]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
本作改編自動畫《魔法小天使》。原作講述10歲女孩森澤優獲得魔力，能夠變身成年紀較大的美少女，後來更成為流行偶像，讓地球居民接觸到銀河系其他地方的生命。優也會在遊戲中登場，但並非主角；玩家將在四段不同的故事中操控四名年輕女性：生活在地球的由理與綺，以及身處異星世界的奧拉與西塔。那顆星球融合了科幻與中世紀奇幻風格。遊戲還加入原作動畫中沒有的劇情，描繪一片名為「終焉」的魔法聖境。那裡生活著眾多奇幻生靈，並召喚四位女主角擔任守護者，為銀河帶回和平。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/mah-no-tenshi-creamy-mami-futatsu-no-sekai]Moby Games[/url]]
